## File: facebookresearch_fairo/server.py

Prompts

```
['run offline label propagation to propagate object masks between video frames using depth and pose data', 'run offline RGB segmentation saving to save annotated RGB images and segmentation maps to disk in COCO format', 'run detector retraining using saved annotation data to retrain a Detectron2 object detection model', 'run the offline dashboard startup to initialize frame count and prepare the annotation interface', 'run offline frame retrieval to fetch RGB and depth data for a specific frame from disk']
```

```
{'run_offline_label_propagation': 'run offline label propagation to propagate object masks between video frames using depth and pose data', 'run_offline_save_rgb_seg': 'run offline RGB segmentation saving to save annotated RGB images and segmentation maps to disk in COCO format', 'run_retrain_detector': 'run detector retraining using saved annotation data to retrain a Detectron2 object detection model', 'run_start_offline_dashboard': 'run the offline dashboard startup to initialize frame count and prepare the annotation interface', 'run_get_offline_frame': 'run offline frame retrieval to fetch RGB and depth data for a specific frame from disk'}
```
